import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from lmfit.models import PseudoVoigtModel, LinearModel
d = pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv'); x = d.shift_cm1.values; y = d.intensity.values
b = np.load('bg.npy')
noise_raw = np.std(np.diff(y))/np.sqrt(2)
print('white-noise sigma from diff:', round(noise_raw,1))
def fit(lo, hi, centers, label):
    m = (x>=lo)&(x<=hi); xx=x[m]; yy=y[m]
    mod = LinearModel(prefix='bg_')
    pars = mod.make_params(intercept=np.median(yy[:10]), slope=0)
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
        pv = PseudoVoigtModel(prefix=f'p{i}_')
        pars.update(pv.make_params())
        pars[f'p{i}_center'].set(value=c, min=c-6, max=c+6)
        pars[f'p{i}_sigma'].set(value=2.5, min=0.5, max=12)
        pars[f'p{i}_amplitude'].set(value=max(yy[np.argmin(abs(xx-c))]-np.median(yy),100)*np.pi*2.5, min=0)
        pars[f'p{i}_fraction'].set(value=0.5, min=0, max=1)
        mod = mod + pv
    res = mod.fit(yy, pars, x=xx)
    print('==', label, 'redchi', round(res.redchi,1), 'chi2/N', round(res.chisqr/len(yy)/noise_raw**2,2))
    for i,c in enumerate(centers):
